jewl.bl_empty: New stories are on their way.
jewl.rsg_intro: Every Jewl ring is cast to order in US sizes 4 to 9, including half sizes. Find yours with a ring you already own.
jewl.rsg_finder_help: Measure the inside diameter of a ring that fits the same finger, edge to edge, in millimetres.
jewl.rsg_between: You're between sizes. We suggest US {{ s }}, the larger one.
jewl.rsg_out: That's outside our range of US 4 to 9. Write to us and we'll make it to measure.
jewl.rsg_tip1: Measure at the end of the day, when fingers are at their largest.
jewl.rsg_tip2: Wide bands fit more snugly. For bands over 5 mm, go up half a size.
jewl.rsg_tip3: If your knuckle is larger than the base of your finger, choose the size that slides over the knuckle.
jewl.rsg_cta: Still unsure? Every ring can be resized for free, up to two sizes.
jewl.res_intro: Fingers change. Every Jewl ring can be resized for free, for as long as you own it, up to two sizes up or down.
jewl.res_s1_d: Write to us with your order number and the new size. We reply within one working day.
jewl.res_s2_d: We email a prepaid, insured shipping label. Pack the ring in its Jewl case.
jewl.res_s3_d: Our goldsmiths cut, rejoin and re-polish the band, then check every stone setting.
jewl.res_s4_d: Your ring returns insured, freshly polished, with its hallmark checked.
jewl.res_t1: Up to two sizes up or down, free, for the life of the ring.
jewl.res_t3: A clean, polish and setting check with every resize.
jewl.res_t4: Full eternity bands can't be cut. We remake them in the new size and charge only for any added stones.
jewl.shp_intro: Every piece is made to order in our Lisbon atelier and ships insured, with tracking, in its Jewl case.
jewl.shp_f1: to make and hallmark each piece
jewl.shp_a1: Pieces are made to order and leave our atelier within 3 weeks. Delivery then takes 2 to 5 working days by express courier.
jewl.shp_a2: Duties and taxes depend on your country. When they apply, they're shown at checkout before you pay.
jewl.shp_a3: Yes. Return unworn pieces within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. We send you a prepaid, insured label.
jewl.shp_q4: Can I return an engraved piece?
jewl.shp_a4: Engraved and made-to-measure pieces are made for you alone, so they can't be returned. They can still be resized for free.
jewl.shp_a5: Each piece comes in a Jewl travel case with its gem report, inside a sealed, unmarked box.
jewl.care_intro: Recycled 18k gold and hard gemstones are made to be worn every day. A little care keeps them bright for generations.
jewl.care_aqua: Warm soapy water and a soft brush. Safe in ultrasonic cleaners.
jewl.care_paraiba: Warm soapy water only. Avoid ultrasonic and steam cleaners, and sudden heat.
jewl.care_topaz: Warm soapy water. Avoid sharp knocks, which can split the crystal.
jewl.care_turq: Porous. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and keep away from water, oils and perfume.
jewl.care_gold: 18k gold is softer than steel. Store pieces apart so they don't scratch each other.
jewl.care_q1: How do I clean my jewelry at home?
jewl.care_a1: Soak it for a few minutes in warm water with a drop of mild soap, brush gently with a soft toothbrush, rinse and pat dry.
jewl.care_q2: When should I take it off?
jewl.care_a2: Before swimming, the gym, gardening or cleaning. Put it on after perfume and lotion.
jewl.care_a3: In its Jewl case or a soft pouch, one piece per compartment, away from sunlight.
jewl.care_a4: Yes. Once a year we clean, polish and check the settings of any Jewl piece for free.
jewl.ct_intro: Write to us about sizing, engraving or a piece made to measure. We reply within one working day.
jewl.ct_sent: Thank you. We'll reply within one working day.
jewl.ct_err: Check the fields below and try again.
jewl.ct_visit_d: Try pieces on and see the stones in daylight. Appointments are private and last an hour.
jewl.announce: Complimentary insured shipping and free resizing for life
jewl.hero_lede: Aquamarines, Paraíba tourmalines and blue topaz, hand-set in recycled 18k gold in our Lisbon atelier.
jewl.s2d: A gem report with every stone over 0.5 ct
jewl.s3d: US 4 – 9 in half sizes, cast to order
jewl.s4d: Up to two sizes, always complimentary
jewl.d_rings: Cast to your size in recycled 18k gold, then set by hand under the microscope. Comes with its gem report and a Jewl travel case.
jewl.d_necklaces: The chain closes with a spring-ring clasp and a sliding bead, so it can be worn at two lengths.
jewl.d_earrings: Posts in solid 18k gold with butterfly backs. Hypoallergenic and made for everyday wear.
jewl.d_bracelets: Each stone sits in its own four-claw setting, with a hidden box clasp and a safety catch.
jewl.made: Made to order · ships in 3 weeks
jewl.c1: Aquamarine drops cut to hold the color of shallow water.
jewl.c2: Open hoops and crescents shaped like the waterline in Cascais.
jewl.c3: Signets and bands made to be engraved and passed on.
jewl.e_title_html: Write it by hand, inside the band
jewl.e_intro: Our engravers cut every inscription by hand with a graver. Choose a lettering style, a metal and your size, and we cast the Nocturne band to order.
jewl.e_view: Inside of the band, shown flat
jewl.e_mm: US {{ s }} · {{ mm }} mm inner diameter
jewl.a_quote_html: “We set every stone as if it were going to be handed down, because most of them will be.”
jewl.a_cite: Inês Carvalho, head setter, Rua da Rosa, Lisbon
jewl.f2: goldsmiths and setters in one workshop
jewl.f3: from your order to a hallmarked piece
jewl.l_body: One letter a month on new stones, atelier news and private previews of each collection.
jewl.l_ok: Thank you. The next letter goes to {{ e }}.
jewl.l_err: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
jewl.ft_about: Fine jewelry in recycled gold and certified stones, made to order in Lisbon.
jewl.b_empty_d: Add a piece and it will wait here for you.
jewl.b_note: Insured shipping is complimentary. Taxes are calculated at checkout.
